import os, subprocess, shutil

def rec_acct(i,name,bal):
    return i.encode().ljust(4,b' ')[:4]+name.encode().ljust(20,b' ')[:20]+str(bal).zfill(10).encode()[:10]
def rec_book(i,title,owner):
    return i.encode().ljust(4,b' ')[:4]+title.encode().ljust(20,b' ')[:20]+owner.encode().ljust(4,b' ')[:4]

def run(name, buyer, seller, book, amount_raw, accounts, books, trans=b''):
    shutil.rmtree('/tmp/exp/data'); os.makedirs('/tmp/exp/data')
    open('/tmp/exp/src/INPUT.DAT','wb').write(buyer.encode().ljust(4)[:4]+seller.encode().ljust(4)[:4]+book.encode().ljust(4)[:4]+amount_raw)
    open('/tmp/exp/data/ACCOUNTS.DAT','wb').write(accounts)
    open('/tmp/exp/data/BOOKS.DAT','wb').write(books)
    open('/tmp/exp/data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT','wb').write(trans)
    out=subprocess.run(['./prog'],cwd='/tmp/exp',capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    a=open('/tmp/exp/data/ACCOUNTS.DAT','rb').read()
    b=open('/tmp/exp/data/BOOKS.DAT','rb').read()
    t=open('/tmp/exp/data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT','rb').read()
    print('---',name,'out=',repr(out))
    print(' acc=',a)
    print(' book=',b)
    print(' trans=',t)

accts=rec_acct('U001','John Doe',100)+rec_acct('U002','Jane Smith',50)
books=rec_book('B001','Python Basics','U002')
for amt in ['0000000000','0000000005','0000000100','0000000101','9999999999','0000010000']:
    run('amt='+amt,'U001','U002','B001',amt.encode(),accts,books)
# subtract more than balance
run('overdraw','U001','U002','B001',b'0000000200',accts,books)
# buyer==seller
run('same','U001','U001','B001',b'0000000010',accts,books)
# amount with spaces/short
run('short3','U001','U002','B001',b'200',accts,books)
# multiple accounts same id
accts2=rec_acct('U001','A',100)+rec_acct('U002','B',50)+rec_acct('U001','C',7)
run('dupacct','U001','U002','B001',b'0000000010',accts2,books)
# multiple books same id, one valid owner
books2=rec_book('B001','First','U003')+rec_book('B001','Second','U002')
run('dupbook','U001','U002','B001',b'0000000010',accts,books2)
# multiple books same id owner seller first then other
books3=rec_book('B001','First','U002')+rec_book('B001','Second','U003')
run('dupbook2','U001','U002','B001',b'0000000010',accts,books3)
PY
